title: Trump unplugs Albo’s bid to control AI
full_text:
Donald Trump smacked down Anthony Albanese’s digital safety agenda on the world stage, using his United Nations address to reject calls for artificial intelligence oversight.
Mr Albanese rejected suggestions Mr Trump’s attacks had undermined his agenda during his week-long trip to the US where he has positioned Australia as a world leader on digital safety, vowing to “stand up for our national interest”.
Despite the disagreement, the two were all smiles as they posed for a selfie during a reportedly warm and positive private chat.
A day after Mr Albanese joined leaders from 19 other nations calling for the establishment of an international institution to help regulate artificial intelligence, Mr Trump used his speech to the United Nations on Wednesday AEST to slam the proposal.
“The United States totally rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control artificial intelligence,” he said. “The very same people who said we’ll all be dead in 12 years because of global warming … these are the same people that are now saying that AI is going to kill us all.”
